name: Bolt
for: Building a full web app from a prompt, in your browser
about: Describe what you want and Bolt writes, runs and deploys the app without installing anything. Good for first projects and quick prototypes. If you already code, an editor like Cursor or Claude Code gives you more control.
pitch: Bolt writes, runs and deploys an app from a prompt, with nothing to install.

name: Supabase
about: The back end most AI app builders connect to. Generous free tier. Turn on Row Level Security for every table before you launch.

name: Stripe
about: Payment Links let you sell without writing payment code. If you do build checkout yourself, verify webhooks with the raw request body.

name: Cloudflare Pages
for: Hosting a site for free, including commercial sites
about: Fast free hosting that deploys from GitHub. A good fit for static sites and simple apps.
